$description: COMPONENT tier — knobs a component genuinely needs and nothing else does. Easy to overdo: `card.padding` is usually just `space.6`, and every unnecessary component token is another thing to maintain in every theme. Add one when a component must be re-skinnable independently of the semantics.

control.$description: Shared by every form control so a Button, Input and Select line up on the same row without anyone measuring.

md.$description: Default. 40px keeps the 44px touch target once you count the focus ring

ring-offset.$description: The offset is what makes one ring work on any background
